package rulefixtures

import (
	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for repeated_c_json_inside_stream_loop: Gin handlers that call c.JSON(...) or c.PureJSON(...) from inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
type Rule334PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func scenario334Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	items := []Rule334PositiveRecord{
		{ID: 1, Name: "alpha"},
		{ID: 2, Name: "beta"},
		{ID: 3, Name: "gamma"},
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		c.JSON(200, item)
	}
}
